niche.habitat: Deep fog valleys and ring-shadow basins
niche.diet: Ambush predation on grazers and gliders
niche.active: Nocturnal and eclipse-active; hides during thermal tide peaks

body: Sessile mantle with three parabolic ear-lobes; expandable wind-shear wing membranes; melanin-rich scales for radiation and acoustic damping.

chains.trait: Parabolic ear-lobes track 5km infrasound with independent rotation
links: High pressure CO2/N2 atmosphere lowers acoustic impedance
Predator uses infrasound to locate prey; prey cannot localize source due to diffraction

skill.effect: The creature's rotating ear-lobes catch distant vibrations, making nearby hidden foes visible and causing them to hesitate before striking. Sonic assaults bounce harmlessly off its reinforced hide.

chains.weakness: Deaf to high-pitched sounds; sudden whistles or sonic blasts stun it.
observe: Lobes rotate independently, tracking faint hums.
Stalks prey silently across fog banks.
Prey freezes and clamps down when the hum reaches a specific pitch.

journal.en: A silence that screams at the ears; it hunts the sound before the sound reaches you.

plausibility.summary: Use ‘detect and roughly bearings at km scale, localize and ambush within tens of meters’; keep high-pitch deafness weakness (elephant-like upper limit).
fixes: Use ‘detect and roughly bearings at km scale, localize and ambush within tens of meters’; keep high-pitch deafness weakness (elephant-like upper limit).

analogues.organism: African elephant infrasound communication and long-range detection (Poole); barn owl asymmetric ears for sound localization in low light.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Wing membranes generate wind-shear vortices to mask approach
links: Giant-driven atmospheric tides create permanent wind shear
Wing vortices match ambient turbulence spectrum
Acoustic signature masked by self-generated turbulence

skill.effect: Its flapping wings stir up swirling air currents that scramble nearby sound waves, masking its presence from auditory hunters. It moves silently through gusts while the wind continues to blow.

chains.weakness: Fails in still air or enclosed spaces; wind direction must match.
observe: Wings ripple continuously, matching wind gusts.
Attacks only during peak thermal tide wind shear.
No sound of movement until the strike unfolds.

journal.en: It wears the wind like a cloak, becoming the silence between the gusts.

plausibility.summary: Replace active vortex matching with passive low-noise membrane geometry and hunting only when environmental wind masks footfall; Shear Hide expires in still air (already in weakness).
fixes: Replace active vortex matching with passive low-noise membrane geometry and hunting only when environmental wind masks footfall; Shear Hide expires in still air (already in weakness).

chains.trait: Melanin-rich scales dampen bio-acoustics and shield radiation
links: Chronic ionizing stress selects for melanin deposition
Melanin increases acoustic impedance mismatch at tissue boundary
Simultaneous radiation shielding and sound absorption

skill.effect: Its heavy, dark scales absorb nearly all sound from its steps, allowing it to creep forward without alerting nearby creatures. The thick armor deflects harsh energy, though its weight makes it move with deliberate slowness.

chains.weakness: Heavy scales limit agility; shedding is required to recover speed.
observe: Dark, matte patches on joints and mantle edges.
Favors high-radiation zones near magnetic valleys.

journal.en: Black scales that drink the storm and swallow the footsteps.

plausibility.summary: Radiation: melanin-rich scales (passive). Stealth: porous fringe tissue and heavy mantle—not melanin mechanism; keep −20% speed from mass.
fixes: Radiation: melanin-rich scales (passive). Stealth: porous fringe tissue and heavy mantle—not melanin mechanism; keep −20% speed from mass.

chains.trait: Mantle inflates to fill tidal cavity and camouflage as rock
links: Tidal locking creates regular pressure changes in sub-aquatic zones
Mantle cavity expands to match external pressure and volume
Textured inflation mimics local geology perfectly

skill.effect: The creature swells its mantle until it resembles a heavy boulder, anchoring itself firmly against the current and shrugging off impacts. It strikes back with crushing force before collapsing into a weary, sluggish form.

chains.weakness: Cannot deflate quickly; vulnerable to burst damage while inflated.
observe: Matches rock texture perfectly when stationary.
Shudders and deflates with a wet sigh after the strike.

journal.en: It becomes the stone, waits for the shadow, and opens its throat.

plausibility.summary: Tie inflation to ocean tidal pools and F11 surge channels, not only 58 h giant orbit; camouflage as mismatched ‘rock lump’ not cryptographic geology.
fixes: Tie inflation to ocean tidal pools and F11 surge channels, not only 58 h giant orbit; camouflage as mismatched ‘rock lump’ not cryptographic geology.

temperament: Patient ambush predator; strikes only when prey is within infrasound range.
secrets: The infrasound dish can be focused to shatter fragile crystal deposits, revealing hidden nutrient veins.
Melanin scales can be used to craft acoustic-dampening armor that reduces incoming sonic damage.
The wind-shear camouflage can be exploited by the player to hide allies in plain sight during strong tides.
moments: The fog parts silently. The prey does not hear the approach, only feels the infrasound hum vibrating in its marrow, and by the time the parabolic ears rotate to locate the sound, the mantle has already unfolded, swallowing the world in a dark, damp gape.

journal.en: A silence that screams at the ears.
It hunts the sound before the sound reaches you.
